title: Obsidian Emerald Gear
description: This minecraft mod adds Emerald / Obsidian tools and armor. That's it.
body:
# Obsidian Emerald Gear Mod

This mod adds emerald and obsidian armour and tools. Specifically made for 1.12.2 since I always wanted a mod like this on 1.12.2 which combined both without other fluff.

I will not publish this mod on CurseForge due to political reasons.

**DO NOT EXPECT LONG TERM SUPPORT FOR THIS MOD, THE ODDS FOR BUGS ARE UNLIKELY, BUT NEVER ZERO.**
